title: Writing --- Four Lines, And The Joiner That Points Back
label: ch:pt-four-lines
canDo: I can write four connected lines to a named reader, adding with e and giving a result with por isso, with the reason placed before it.

payoff.summary: Complete PT-W258-four-lines: four lines to one reader, at least one joined with e and one with por isso, then check the reason stands before por isso.
payoff.note: The track has not taught a word for because, so the reason link is por isso, which points back: the reason comes first and the result follows. Swapping the halves stays grammatical and reverses the claim, which is what the wrap-up check catches.
